title: Rolling-window limit across tenants
prompt: A gateway enforces max_requests per tenant in a rolling time window. It currently uses one global timestamp list and drops requests exactly at the window boundary incorrectly. Fix RateLimiter.allow(tenant, now) in limiter.py. Each tenant has its own limit; requests older than or exactly window seconds expire; denied requests must not consume quota; reject nonpositive limits/windows. Run visible tests and validate.
